quest.title: Mortal Pursuit
quest.description: Coya attacked humans to rescue her daughter. The clues point toward a craftsperson named Tepal...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x475, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.num: Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers: Act III
chapter.title: Guns and Wings

talks.objective: Go to the Children of Echoes to gather intel
Go to the Children of Echoes to gather intel

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Allpa says that Tepal's from the Children of Echoes. But how do we track him down? Just... ask around until we find him?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let's start by talking to someone we know. It'll be faster that way. At this time and place, I'll bet the easiest person to find is:

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Wakey-wakey, Xilonen.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: *yawn* Ah, it's you... Ugh, okay... Give me a second, I'll come down...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: *yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you two both love climbing trees...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I climb trees to fly further and see farther. I don't usually stop for a nap.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Well, we're not all like you — always full of energy, even after flying around all day... So. You've come all this way and interrupted my precious nap time. Might I inquire as to why?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Xilonen, but it couldn't wait. Does the name "Tepal" mean anything to you? He's a craftsman, apparently.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Tepal? Yes, that rings a bell... I think that's Puma's child.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is he in the tribe right now?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Nope, I'm afraid you're a few years too late... Why are you looking for him?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You try to explain what happened simply and briefly...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: "Phlogiston Wings"? Wow, okay. The kid actually pulled it off... Well, looks like no more rest for me today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pulled it off? You mean he's tried making something like this before?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Yeah, he started trying to build a flying machine right after he got back from the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: So right after he went wingless, then... Was this flying machine anything like the gun you made me?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: You mean, your gun that's harder to tame than the proudest qucusaur? No, he wanted to build something that allows anyone to fly freely, even if they're not naturally gifted.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: But... he never got very far back then, though. Blew up his workshop a few times and barely made it out alive. I never really kept up with him after that.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: His parents traveled a lot in their youth, and only returned to the tribe after he was born. But they settled in a remote area, and don't interact with other people much.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Which means, most people in the tribe don't know them very well... Your best bet is to chat to his direct family.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I'll go get Puma. Wait for me in front of the workshop, I won't be long.

talks.objective: Go to Xilonen's workshop and wait there

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A short while later, at Xilonen's workshop...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I'm back. Allow me to introduce Tepal's mother, Puma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello! We're—

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: Save the pleasantries. I don't want to spend any longer talking about that boy than I have to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: I disowned him long ago... He is no child of mine!

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: All he cared about was his pipe dream of reaching the sky... We tried to talk sense into him, but he was obsessed!

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: Hmph... Then when he left us, he spouted some nonsense about building a workshop in the sky to avoid the constant criticism of us ground-dwellers...

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: He left his notebook behind. Whatever questions you have, you can look for them in there — I'm done talking about him.

dialogues.speaker: Puma
dialogues.text: He is no son of mine... He never called me "Mom" anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, they've really fallen out... Paimon sure wasn't expecting that...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Her husband, Tepal's father... he passed away recently, and Tepal didn't even bother to show his face at the funeral.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: If you ask me, that was probably the final straw for Puma.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I'll go keep her company. If there's anything else you need, just come and find me.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so this notebook is the only lead we've got now, right? What's in there?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm... some early designs for the Phlogiston Wings... and some theorizing about an airborne workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ochkanatlan, the Cinder City... Looks like that's where he got his technological inspiration from.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he was serious about the workshop in the sky? But that's such a big project for one person... do we think he actually pulled it off?

choices.text: Actually, look at that balloon sketch...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Oh! Yes! The one from the trial arena that was super high up!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: That balloon has been there for a while, and everyone's been wondering how it got up there. But... what if that's the wrong question?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: What if it started off even higher up, above the clouds and out of view, and it only descended to its current height due to some kind of malfunction?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In other words, it could be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Part of Tepal's workshop?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Seems likely. If Tepal's base had been hiding above the clouds this whole time, that would definitely explain why Isidore couldn't find it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon totally called it... But um, how do we get up there? Chasca, can you even fly that high?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: By myself... possibly. But with a passenger, no chance.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I doubt even Phlogiston Wings could take you up that high... at least, not without that "relic" Tepal mentioned in his notebook.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and he's probably holding onto it... We'll have to find another way.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Can you fly up that high, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, that's waaay beyond Paimon's altitude! Also, would you really expect Paimon to go up there and take on Tepal all by herself?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Let's not worry. Just because we can't think of a solution doesn't mean no one else can. I'm not the only flying expert in my tribe, you know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, good point. We should go ask Elder Allpa!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: And Mutota. He was quite the flying ace back in the day, too. Let's head back and see what they suggest.

choices.text: Haven't we seen that somewhere before?

talks.objective: Return to the Flower-Feather Clan and discuss the plan

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: Chasca, you're finally back! Things are getting really tense in the tribe. Have you made any headway with your investigation?

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: Some people think we arrested the merchants just to support the flying squad and crack down on the Phlogiston Wings.

choices.text: If things are still escalating even though we've rounded up the merchants...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: We've found some promising leads, but there's a major obstacle standing between us and the irrefutable evidence we need...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Chasca explains what you found out about Tepal, and your theory about the airborne workshop...

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: A relic from the Cinder City? Ugh... so Och-Kan's still managing to sow discord, even after all these years...

response.speaker: Allpa
response.text: An airborne workshop... and a hot air balloon above the trial arena... And that's where you're trying to get to now?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any ideas how we can get up there?

response.speaker: Allpa
response.text: Neither Phlogiston Wings nor a qucusaur can take you that high up. Do you really think that's where Tepal is hiding?

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: Hmm... You know what... There might just be a way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really!?

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: Do you still remember those spouts in the arena? When they were all blocked, the gaseous phlogiston was trapped and unable to flow.

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: But now, it's flowing freely. If we were to block them up again...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You mean... All of them except the one at the very top of the arena? To build up the pressure there?

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: Precisely. With all the gaseous phlogiston flowing through one spout, it would create a high-pressure wind current...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then we just ride it up into the sky.

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: Yes. It has its risks, but with Chasca's abilities, I think she could manage it...

response.speaker: Allpa
response.text: It's an extremely risky approach... but I agree that it's feasible.

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: If you want to give it a try, check with Inkanak at the trial grounds. She can explain how to block the spouts.

response.speaker: Mutota
response.text: Chasca... If anyone has a hope of seizing this evidence from the high heavens, it is you.

choices.text: Maybe there are other parties out there fanning the flames too?

talks.objective: Go to the trial site and talk to Inkanak

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hurry to the trial arena and explain the situation to Inkanak...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Goodness me... That is a very bold idea...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Maybe so, but we have to act fast. What's the quickest way for us to block off the spouts?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: From a technical perspective, I'd have to advise taking some measurements and carefully planning this out first... But I'm guessing that's not what you want to hear?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: ...Then we'll have to take the rough-and-ready approach. See the solid phlogiston over there?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Our prior inspections revealed that some kind of stable structure has formed inside, making it highly damage-resistant...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: It's not without its weak points, but unless they're all struck at the same time, the structural integrity won't be threatened...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... what happens if we do strike them all at once?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: It'll collapse.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...Okay, I see where you're going with this.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Yeah, you got it! As long as you hit all the weak spots at once from the right angle, the solid phlogiston will fall right on top of the spout, and block it up.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You're right about "rough and ready"... Sounds like my kind of plan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Oof... Paimon's never flown that fast before... She feels ready to throw up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: At least we made it in one piece.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ah-hah... just as I thought. It might look like a regular hot air balloon from the outside, but up close, it's clearly been heavily remodeled.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: And sure enough, it only descended below the cloud line because the custom-built machinery malfunctioned.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell what the issue is?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I should be able to figure it out, with Tepal's notebook. Thankfully, I know a little DIY from fixing up my guns when they're having issues.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm... That should just about do it. Now all it needs is a nice, hard kick...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Maybe that works on your guns, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? We're really moving!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hmm? How's the sleuthing going?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're good for now. How is Puma doing?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hanging in there — she seems to have calmed down now. I'll check in with her again later.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I think something about handing you that notebook meant she was finally able to let go of a few things. So maybe this was for the best.

dialogues.speaker: Huascar
dialogues.text: No more qucusaurs! We want Phlogiston Wings!

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Have you gone mad? The qucusaurs are our partners!

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: We'll do our best to manage the conflict within the tribe while you're gone. Hopefully it'll buy you some time.

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: Chief, we should put a defense plan in place... just in case.

talks.objective: Go to the top of the mountain

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It actually worked... But wait, how are Paimon and {NICKNAME} supposed to get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Coya can give you a lift. She's actually been following us this whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Paimon didn't notice at all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why didn't she come and join us?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Probably because she didn't want to get too close to humans... Or maybe just me. But right now, we need her power.

dialogues.speaker: Coya
dialogues.text: Cheep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You didn't even have to summon her...

dialogues.speaker: Coya
dialogues.text: ...Cheep.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Yes, up there... That's probably where Chime is.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's go have a little talk with this Tepal.

talks.objective: Go to the top of the mountain
Get on the hot air balloon
Get on the hot air balloon

dialogues.speaker: Coyllur
dialogues.text: Although I get where they're coming from, isn't bad-mouthing the qucusaurs going a step too far?

dialogues.speaker: Zhunan
dialogues.text: But without the Phlogiston Wings, I'll never make it...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: As long as you hit all the weak spots at once from the right angle, the solid phlogiston will fall right on top of the spout, and block it up.

dialogues.speaker: Huascar
dialogues.text: We want Phlogiston Wings...

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Have you gone mad...

dialogues.speaker: Coyllur
dialogues.text: Although I get where they're coming from...

dialogues.speaker: Zhunan
dialogues.text: But without the Phlogiston Wings...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The currents high in the sky are extremely turbulent. Chasca brings you back down to the ground safely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There's a chunk of solid phlogiston right over that spout!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm... We need a clear shot. Let's get rid of these obstacles first.
